headline: JBL Live Beam 3 earbuds with screen drop to $100
summary: Earbuds with ANC, touchscreen case, and 12hr battery life
details: The JBL Live Beam 3 earbuds originally retailed for $200 but are now available for $100. They offer excellent sound quality, great ANC performance, and good EQ control. The earbuds also feature a smart touchscreen case.

The screen on the charging case allows users to control media, adjust volume, and switch audio profiles without needing to pull out their phone. The earbuds support multipoint connectivity, most hi-res codecs, and offer up to 12 hours of battery life with a single charge.
Additional features include ANC powered by six microphones, Bluetooth 5.3 with LE Audio, JBL Spatial Sound, and Personi-Fi 3.0. The earbuds also support wireless charging.

headline: Wealthy parents pay $75,000 for AI-taught schools
summary: Some US parents are paying tens of thousands for AI-based education
details: Some wealthy American parents are paying tens of thousands of dollars for their children to attend schools that use AI tutors and interactive project-based workshops. Companies like Forge Prep and Alpha School are offering this type of education, with prices as high as $75,000 per year.

The approach is being adopted by some Silicon Valley parents, who see it as a way to give their children an edge in education. However, there are concerns about the effectiveness of AI in teaching children to 'think on their feet and navigate the world'.

Alpha School co-founder MacKenzie Price has said that the school will avoid 'hot-button social issues' in the classroom, which could include topics like women's rights, slavery, and immigration. This approach has raised concerns about the type of education being provided.
